Operator decision (2026-11-18): HOLD publication of the rewritten tickets history. Do not publish the reclaim to origin/tickets until tame-melodious-veery is fixed so an enforced `verify-identity` completes on the whole store, and that enforced check PASSES on the rewritten history. Real-data dry-run evidence (8dc4) stands: pack 626.7 MiB -> 106.5 MiB, commits 309,878 -> 13,196, reduced state identical for 10,296 tickets, advisory identity counts unchanged (49,544 signed / 874 unsigned). Publication remains a separate human go after that check passes.

Operator decision (2026-11-18): close 51a7 mystical-capsizable-ibis as wontfix. The dry run shows the .retired sweep is not needed for the pack reduction, and its plan review blocked on fsck/snapshot-rebuild and retired-event readers.
